asr.full_text: Crypto Revenue Hello my amazing friends! It's great to have you back on my YouTube channel. For more than 3 years, I've been diving into the fascinating world of cryptocurrency and exploring various methods to earn money online. In today's video I am excited to share how you can make money through Cryptocurrency Arbitrage. With this technique, you could potentially see a return of 11% on your investment in just 5 minutes. Today's spotlight… Litecoin. Cryptocurrency prices are constantly fluctuating so I won't provide specific numbers, as they may change by the time you view this video. However, this is precisely what makes cryptocurrencies so intriguing. Their volatility opens up numerous opportunities for substantial profits. We'll capitalize on the price discrepancies across different exchanges to generate profit. I'll guide you through the entire arbitrage process step-by-step, ensuring that it's easy for you to follow along. Our method is quite simple. We'll buy Litecoin on one exchange, like Binance, Coinbase or Bybit and then sell it on Mallorybit. Generally, the price of Litecoin on Malorybit is about 10% to 15% higher than on Binance. Our goal is to acquire Litecoin on Binance and swiftly sell it on Mallorybit for an estimated 11% profit. Exchanges we are using The first exchange we will be using is Binance, which has been a leading cryptocurrency trading platform since 2017 and has a significant presence on social media. The second exchange is MeloReBit, active in the crypto market since 2019 and well-followed on platforms like Instagram, Telegram and Twitter. Now that you know about these exchanges, it's time to start making some money. Remember, you can find links to both platforms in the video description Be sure to check them out! Launching Our Arbitrage Strategy Let's start our Arbitrage journey with an initial investment of $20,000. First, head over to the MelaryBit website and find the deposit section and copy the Litecoin wallet address, go to Binance and navigate to the withdraw tab, choose Litecoin, paste the MalloryBit wallet, enter the amount you wish to withdraw, and confirm the transaction. Once your Litecoin appears in your Mallorybitit account, you're all set to move forward. Go to the trading section and sell your Litecoin at a price that's 10% to 15% higher than what you paid on Binance. For instance, if I bought $20,000 worth of Litecoin and sold it for $22,200, that nets me a profit of $2,200. Now it's time to transfer your profits to any wallet of your choice. I'll be sending mine back to Binance. To do this, go to the Withdrawal Funds section. Input your Binance wallet address and specify the amount, which was $22,200 for me. For quicker transactions, I recommend using USDT TRC 20. After that, return to Mailery Pit. Enter your Binance wallet address along with the amount you want to withdraw. Click the Withdraw Funds button, and your money will be sent to your Binance balance. And that's all there is to it. This video illustrates how you can profit through arbitrage effectively. The best part is that with each withdrawal, you can consistently grow your deposits and earnings. As you can see on your screens, I made over 2,200 dollars in profit in just 10 minutes, with only a few trades. I strongly encourage you to take advantage of this strategy while it's still viable. Thank you for tuning in today! Don't forget to subscribe to the channel and leave your thoughts in the comments below.
